timeline.text: There is no one I adore more, you who must have risked life and limb to be here with me forevermore.
The last words I wrote before I was cast into this endless abyss,
by the immortals seeking to protect this world and all of its inhabitants.
Wrapped in darkness, alone, void of all emotion,
I once more feel a presence signaling my return,
love's fervent seal, a spark of light in this ocean.
Now there is but little left for you to do before I am free and we can be together.
And those who trapped me within these pages shall rue locking away this beauty forever.
Apologize?
You, who should be amongst my most dearest and beloved followers,
who has freed me from that prison, who has shown me your love above all others.
You then act like you don't even know who I am?
Why would you toy with my emotions?
I'm, I'm sorry, I'm not sure what you mean.
You're not sure what I mean?
Are you mocking me now?
If you truly do not know who I am, then why is it that you set me free?
If not for my love, and if not by your love, then for what?
With a prize like that, I had to come find a book, no matter the danger.
Little could I have known the true nature of the book, though.
Enough! I've heard enough.
Though now that I recount my story, it does seem it really was me who released you.
Kiara? I need you.
Oh. The legendary phoenix. The mighty, fiery Kiara. Friends with a witch.
It's almost funny. Did you not realize? It was your witch friend who freed me.
It's almost funny. Did you not realize? It was your witch friend who freed me.
Liar! She would never do such a ghastly thing.
I trust she would stay away from the dark magics and demonic rituals.
To suggest otherwise is just another one of your dark lies.
She didn't deserve to die.
Poor phoenix. Still so trusting of those around you and unable to see through their deceptions.
Your kind spirit constantly deceives you.
That witch was never your friend. We all know they cannot be trusted.
Even after all these years, you still have not changed.
Still believing in lies and still so easily misled.
Still such a fool.
It is you who is the fool, demon!
Your lust for love and attention continues to lead you down the path of death and destruction.
And you don't even see that you are the one destroying your own happiness.
The gods are right to confine you there.
You, who are still shackled by your lust for love.
Your desire for attention? Your desire to be worshipped?
I am the demon of sound!
How dare you speak to me in such a manner?
It is but right that all should worship me on their knees.
Their love for none but myself.
Leave. I have heard enough of your falsities.
Only they are said to be able to free me. Explain yourself! What's going on?
I'm sorry. I have a lot to explain, but we don't have time now. We need to go. Now! Death is coming for you.
What?
Please, come with me. I know a way in which we can hide from death, but we have to leave now, before it's too late.
I'm not going anywhere with you until you explain to me what is going on. Now! Why would you send a witch to free me, Iris?
Seelie, I had no choice.
You had no choice. You could have sent one of my followers instead.
You don't have any more followers! They're all dead! They all died long ago.
What? No, that can't be. Has it been that long?

I'm afraid the Demon of Sound has been freed from the void again, and is in the world once more. Her long confinement has ended, and she is the same as she has ever been, quick to anger, blinded by her lust for adoration. And this time, I was the second victim of her lust for love and blood.
You? Murdered? By that love-obsessed demon?

Yes, and her first victim was a good friend of mine too. Forgive me, Lord Death, but this injustice cannot stand. Unfortunately, her power is already beyond my ability to stop. Please, you must do something to stop that demon, that monster! She will surely only take more lives, and plunge the world into further chaos.

Come on, quick! Ascent to the world of the living with your great siphon hand, and reap the life of the Demon of Sound before she can claim another victim. Avenge my life, and the life of my friend. I beg you.
That demon cannot be left to ravage the world once more. I warned the other gods before, but here we are! It is time I take this into my own hand, and do what I should have done long ago.
Silence!

Your bloodlust and desire for adoration has clouded your judgment, to the point where you can't even tell friend from foe anymore. You're the one who brought bloody doom upon your own beloved friend, and yourself. Your fear of losing your hold over things brings about the very result you so fear.
How dare you!
Continue on with your excuses, blame who you will for your own misdoing if you wish. In the end, you have only yourself to blame for the situation you find yourself in.
A lust for love so strong that those you love turn away. A desire for power so overwhelming, those you have power over turn on you.
An anger so deep that you destroy all who might have helped save you. Your fate has been sealed by your own hand. And now, I am now here to deliver it to you.
Time and time again, you gave in to your nature. Vanishing you to a void was supposed to be a chance for you to reflect on your past, but has only proven that you are truly unfit for this world.
You are such a misguided fool. Your reckless ways have brought black doom upon yourself and those most beloved around you. Blaming your misery on everyone else.

You are such a misguided fool. Your reckless ways have brought black doom upon yourself and those most beloved around you. Blaming your misery on others when your demise was, in fact, forged by your own hands. While you have earned your death in full, it is with pity, not anger, that this blade falls.

And welcome to my 3D concert. My first technically solo one, as you can see up here, is the hashtag for today, which is hashtag Requiem for Love 3D. I'm watching the chat. Did you guys enjoy it? Did you like it? Do you have fun? I sure hope so.

Well, obviously a lot just happened, but I must let you all know this was all a musical, so none of it was real. No one is hurt. There was no Hololive Girls hurt in the making of this musical, so please don't worry.
This stage is awesome, so I want to give it up to the team over at Hololive Productions who put this all together. Can we just take a look, take a moment to admire this beautiful stage before us?

Some of the more lesser shown details I kind of wanted to highlight a little bit, so let's go ahead and take a look at Mayhaps the Moon, maybe? Look at that big thing in the background. It was also dark red at one point, but currently it is, as it probably should be, normal, beautiful because I was killed.

We also have the giant castle in the background, which is, oh my gosh, I was so excited for this. I was like, oh, I want something that's really kind of like cathedral-esque and dark and gothic, and they fully delivered. I was so, so pleased with how it ended up looking in the final, so happy.

So I'm going to open them up for you and to try flying for a little bit, so yeah, there we go. What do you think? I am capable of flight. Obviously, it's a little slow, but I'm working on it. I'm working on my muscles, so I'll figure it out eventually. It's been a while. I was locked up for like 9,000 years. Cut me some slack.

Well, this is all very exciting, so again, I'm so happy to have you here. I wanted to talk a little bit about, I have an announcement after this, but before that, I wanted to talk a little bit about just the making of this.
Well, we had so many lovely guests first and foremost. First, we started off with Shiori Novella, who was our beautiful, cute witch who came here maybe not knowing what she was getting into.

Then we had Takanashi Kiara, the brave, amazing phoenix, came in trying to avenge her friend, but ended up getting bested by the best. Then we had Iris, my Nephilim friend, friends as we're both demons, kind of.
And then, last but not least, of course, we had the Calliope Mori come in and take my life, as she should have, because, wow, I was kind of mean in that musical, don't you think?

Not exactly the way that I usually am, so kind, but regardless, it was really fun. I came up with the idea for the story, and I wanted something that was a little more exciting, a little more Toonibyou,

because deep down, I am cringe, but I am free, so I hope you enjoyed the concept. We had amazing scriptwriters, and just the whole team working on all of this was so amazing, so thank you for everyone who put in their efforts into this.
It seriously means so much to me, and audience, jailbirds, thank you so much for watching. I hope you had a wonderful time.

This features the necklace from my DEO outfit. It is silver, and it has a tiny amethyst color gem, because it's kind of hard to tell, but the gem on my actual necklace is not red, it is actually kind of purpley, so please look forward to it.

Next up is the Complete Set Purchase Bonus Limited Edition version. It's going to come with a postcard with a handwritten autograph by yours truly, and of course the art is going to be the same one that's featured in the plush blanket, the art by Yomo Sakasan.
So, please do consider getting it if you want the whole set, if you want the limited set. Next up is a regular Complete Set.

This is going to come with a postcard with a duplicated foil stamp autograph by me, in the case that you miss out on the limited, but you'll still get my signature either way, so don't worry too much.
And both the limited and complete set are going to be coming with a bonus voice pack called A Late Night at the Office, featuring me of course, and you, who works in my office, Jailbird.

So, that is all of my merchandise. Please, please buy it. I hope you like it. Again, this is a celebration for 850,000K, and I would be remiss to not say that this is all thanks to you guys and your support.
So, thank you so, so much for supporting me, for following me, for watching my covers, for watching this today, watching my streams, commenting, everything you guys do. I'm so grateful.
So, thank you so much. So, that's the final full set. And yeah, it's all good. So, please buy it. I hope you guys like it. I hope you're looking forward to receiving the items.

relatedStreams.title: 1回でSSR3人、それでも持ち帰れない　NerissaがStarSaviorで「ガチャを回す喜び」を満喫
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 約1時間の案件配信から、Nerissaの大当たりガチャと、自分のアカウントではないことへの惜しさ、ゲームへの興味までをまとめて追える

relatedStreams.title: Nerissa Ravencroft、『AGREE』の「同意」地獄に挑戦　2時間で10/12まで進む
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: Nerissa Ravencroftが、FUWAMOCOとBibooに勧められたゲーム『AGREE』に挑戦した。配信後にダンスレッスンを控え、使える時間は約2時間。ゲームを始めるための「同意」は一度押せば終わりではなく、パズルや計算、料理、認証コード入力などへ次々と姿を変えてNerissaを足止めする。最後まで「Doki Doki Action Game」にたどり着けないまま、それでも12段階中10まで進めて配信を終えた。

relatedStreams.title: NerissaとInaがAmiAmiでクリスマスギフト探し　店内を巡って見つけた「相手らしい一品」
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: AmiAmiの豊富な商品を見ながら、二人が相手や仲間を思い浮かべてクリスマスギフトを選ぶ買い物企画です。
